Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 5) demonstrates opacity and volume loss in the right lower lung zone with a shift of mediastinal structures toward the right, consistent with right lower lobe atelectasis. Combined with the clinical history of prolonged cough, repetitive pneumonia, and prior neurological event (hemiparesis suggesting aspiration risk), this presentation is most characteristic of a retained foreign body causing chronic obstruction and atelectasis.
